messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Shiny Server news
parts:
Hi all, we've just posted some Shiny news on the RStudio blog. The Shiny package is now on CRAN, and Shiny Server will be free/open source when we release it in January (as a beta).

http://blog.rstudio.org/2012/12/04/shiny-update/

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server news
parts:
Thanks for the kind words, everyone!

Feature wise, I don't expect it will be much different than what is running on glimmer today, except that it will be a bit more configurable by the admin for URLs that don't match the /username/appname pattern. Plus the much needed error logging. Supporting both of those requires significant refactoring and will take a lot of time between now and the end of January, plus packaging and documentation.
